description: Expiring task leases: claim (lease_seconds) → submit (deliverable_ids, note) → project lead reviews (decision, note). renew/release your lease; reopen challenges a result (note=reason). A held lease → lease_conflict with lease_expires_at. Coordination only.

idempotency_key.description: Retry the exact mapped REST request with this key for 24 hours. A committed outcome is never executed again.
